items.activity: Drive to Kurunegala (via Outer Circular Hwy + Central Expressway E04)
items.why: Expressway is fastest and emptiest at this hour
First natural break after ~1h40 of driving
Regular A-road once off the expressway
No point idling for restaurants to open here — better to cover ground first and eat once we're actually at Kantale
Same leg as before, just moved ahead of breakfast instead of after it
By 7:00 AM, arriving right at the kayaking put-in, Kantale's own roadside eateries should be open — no need to wait at Habarana first
items.note: ⚠️ Not independently verified like the Habarana/Dambulla zone; worth a same-day check with the kayaking operator, who'll know what's actually open

items.why: Extended from 90 to 120 min — cool morning air and calm water before the tank gets breezy and hot by late morning. Starts immediately after breakfast since the group is already there — no second drive needed

Reclaimed from cutting the old idle restaurant-wait and the redundant post-breakfast drive to Kantale. Deliberately left open rather than assigned, so a delay anywhere upstream (or a longer kayaking session) doesn't threaten Koneswaram's close time or the 6:00 PM Verandas target

items.activity: Drive to lunch venue (Trincomalee town area, via Velgam Vehera/Kanniya area, no stop — both moved to Day 2)
items.why: Velgam Vehera and Kanniya are skipped here, not driven around — they're picked up on Day 2's route home from Nilaveli instead
Midday heat — good time to be seated indoors
Calm, shallow, shaded resort beach handles early-afternoon heat better than an exposed public beach
Late-afternoon light, cooler air, temple open until 6:45 PM
items.note: ⚠️ Restriction: shoulders and knees must be covered and shoes removed before entering — plan a quick change out of beachwear at Marble Beach or on the bus. Vehicles drive through a checkpoint (ID may be checked) to a large car park, then it's a ~200 m walk up to the temple.

items.why: Same arrival time as the original plan. The later breakfast, longer kayaking, and a 70-min contingency buffer are all absorbed by dropping Velgam Vehera/Kanniya from Day 1 and cutting the old idle restaurant-wait
